description:
***Amendment 0002 revises the solicitation to: (1) extend the Request for Information (RFI) deadline to December 14, 2026; 
(2) revise SDVOSB bonding requirements; (3) clarify evaluation credit for Joint Venture members and formally documented 
team members; (4) clarify Healthcare Facility experience requirements and concurrent project experience criteria; (5) 
revise past performance evaluation to a Pass/Fail methodology and associated submission requirements; (6) revise MATOC 
award and ceiling language; and (7) update task order competition procedures, including Rule of Two procedures.  Affected Attachments and Appendices have been uploaded with tracked changes as necessary; previous/obsolete versions have been removed and replaced.*** 

 The VA requires multiple indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) type contracts to provide construction services enterprise wide. 

 The objective of this procurement is to award multiple IDIQ MATOCs for construction services nationwide within specified pools. These pools will meet the VA infrastructure needs for construction, renovation, maintenance, and repair within the 50 United States and its territories. 

 The MATOC will consist of three (3) SDVOSB Pools with a minimum of ten (10) awardees each and one (1) National Unrestricted Pool with a minimum of ten (10) awardees. The SDVOSB Pools will be set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business.  

 Please see RFP, attachments, and appendices for further information.
